mutations.name: a loop with no tier is not mapped to the Unsorted tray
mutations.find: export const tierKeyOf = (tier: LoopTier): TierKey => (tier === null ? "unsorted" : tier);
mutations.replace: export const tierKeyOf = (tier: LoopTier): TierKey => tier as TierKey;
kills: loops page puts a loop with no tier in the Unsorted tray

mutations.name: cards inside a tier ignore tier rank
kills: loops page orders cards inside a tier by tier rank

mutations.name: a refused move is not rolled back
kills: loops page moves a card back when the console refuses the tier write
